items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Yeah, my cousin owned a place, Old Man and the Umpers.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's on the way up to Tulane University. There's not four of them up there. Yeah, we'd go by there every time we'd. That's right.

That's where I used to live. That's where I used to live. The number was what, 40? 4431 Forest Street. 4431. Yeah, my cousin owned a place, Old Man and the Umpers. I don't know if you've heard of him. Oh, Jim. Jim, Old Jim Umpers. Old Jim, the old man that taught music. That's right. He owned...
